a: REST exposes fixed endpoints; GraphQL lets clients ask for specific fields.
Idempotent means repeating the same request has the same effect.
Version APIs (/v1) to avoid breaking old clients.
Pagination returns results in pages with limit and cursor or offset.
Bearer tokens are sent in the Authorization header.
Webhooks let a server push events to your URL.
APIs often return remaining quota in response headers.
Return structured JSON errors with a clear message and code.
Clients should set timeouts so hung requests fail fast.
Good docs show auth, examples, errors, and rate limits.
